description: A gray T-shirt lies on a yellow tabletop in front of you, with a brown curtain hanging in the background. Both hands move in toward the shirt and lift it as a two-hand object, then spread it flat; the right hand folds one side inward and the left hand aligns the bottom edge before both hands bring the fabric over into a long rectangle. The right hand then folds the rectangle into a smaller bundle while the left hand steadies and smooths it, leaving a neatly folded shirt on the table.
